lastCompletedStory.title: Add shared report parse module and relax WorkerReport optional fields

nextStoryContext: report-parse.ts (parseWorkerReport/parseReviewReport) is tested but NOT yet wired into any consumer: host.ts's makeReadWorkerReport and result.ts's readWorkerOutcome still use their own ad-hoc isObject/typeof guards. A follow-up story should replace those duplicated guards with calls into report-parse.ts if/when the PRD calls for it -- this story's AC only required the shared module + the WorkerReport.gates/notes optionality, not consumer rewiring. WorkerReport.gates/notes are now optional at the type level; any new code reading report.gates.X must use optional chaining (report.gates?.X) or a truthiness guard.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure hand-rolled TypeScript type-narrowing (isObject/typeof guards), no external parsing library introduced (project convention forbids zod / *.schema.json runtime loaders here).
